name: statements
note: Two annotated rules, one of them recursive: the innermost commit wins.

name: block
note: A repetition closed by a terminal; the commit is inside a recursive rule.

name: separated
note: Items of a separated list followed by a closing terminal.

name: parameterized-mapping
note: Expanded calls, a token and AST captures: captures stay inside COMMIT.

name: not-inserted
note: @autoCommit on a rule whose failure an enclosing choice can resume inserts nothing: 'ay' stays accepted.

name: group-after-commit
note: A group follows the committed reference: the Java group helpers keep their numbers, so the CST is unchanged (review of #724).
